acceptanceCriteria: go version under heavy.sh in interop/cem01-go reports go1.27.2.
A script case covers the nested module.
body: Residual from lane perf-1022s (PR beamfall/corvint#1552, seal aaa260d44). After ASD-V0-014, go commands run through heavy.sh inside interop/cem01-go (its own module) still resolve go1.27.3 rather than the pinned go1.27.2.
title: heavy.sh still gives interop/cem01-go go1.27.3 after the V1-2384 pin fix
